{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Kernel label, introduces `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, and isolates non-deterministic clock symbols from `libbitcoinkernel`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "It adds a kernel C API to set clock time on chainstate manager instances and prevents non-deterministic clock calls from linking into the kernel library. This addresses the core library goal of enabling external callers to run validation deterministically without relying on global mock time or system clocks."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/txmempool.h` and `src/txmempool.cpp` only to mechanically update time types (`NodeClock::time_point`).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect mempool policy, validation rules, or acceptance logic; changes to mempool files are mechanical type updates following the time refactoring."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches `src/rpc/mempool.cpp` for a single-line call update.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not add or modify RPC methods or interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test files and benchmarks adapt callers to the new time types and test the kernel API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Fixing an intermittent race in `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks` and adding tests for kernel API functions belong to their respective areas rather than core test harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Separates `now()` symbols into `time_nondet.cpp` solely to enforce `libbitcoinkernel` link-time invariants.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The utility time changes serve the kernel boundary isolation rather than general utility primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Validation label and changes in `src/validation.cpp` routing time checks (block header future time, IBD status) through `ChainstateManager::Now()`.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "It replaces global time queries in chainstate validation checks with instance-scoped time and resolves an intermittent test race in IBD status calculation. The underlying consensus validation behavior in production remains unchanged."
    }
  ],

categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Kernel label, introduces `btck_chainstate_manager_set_clock_time` in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, and isolates non-deterministic clock symbols from `libbitcoinkernel`.
categories.rationale: It adds a kernel C API to set clock time on chainstate manager instances and prevents non-deterministic clock calls from linking into the kernel library. This addresses the core library goal of enabling external callers to run validation deterministically without relying on global mock time or system clocks.

categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Touches `src/txmempool.h` and `src/txmempool.cpp` only to mechanically update time types (`NodeClock::time_point`).
categories.rationale: Does not affect mempool policy, validation rules, or acceptance logic; changes to mempool files are mechanical type updates following the time refactoring.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Only touches `src/rpc/mempool.cpp` for a single-line call update.
categories.rationale: Does not add or modify RPC methods or interfaces.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes to test files and benchmarks adapt callers to the new time types and test the kernel API.
categories.rationale: Fixing an intermittent race in `chainstatemanager_ibd_exit_after_loading_blocks` and adding tests for kernel API functions belong to their respective areas rather than core test harness infrastructure.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Separates `now()` symbols into `time_nondet.cpp` solely to enforce `libbitcoinkernel` link-time invariants.
categories.rationale: The utility time changes serve the kernel boundary isolation rather than general utility primitives.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Validation label and changes in `src/validation.cpp` routing time checks (block header future time, IBD status) through `ChainstateManager::Now()`.
categories.rationale: It replaces global time queries in chainstate validation checks with instance-scoped time and resolves an intermittent test race in IBD status calculation. The underlying consensus validation behavior in production remains unchanged.
